high_level_description: The image depicts a stylish individual walking on a city street. The person is wearing a long, emerald green coat with a bow at the collar and double-breasted buttons. Underneath the coat, they have on a white dress adorned with a vibrant floral pattern featuring red and green hues. The individual is also wearing black sunglasses and cream-colored high-heeled shoes. In the background, there is another person dressed in a white blouse and black pants, holding what appears to be a light blue leash or cord.
